thread:
morgan: Heads-up: brief quiet window in ~10m to roll a tiny runtime header normalization that also touches router matching rules. will be quick but need console flag gating + API soft-accept.

diego: window length? can we squeeze into 20m?

morgan: yep 20m. start 1769501200. plan: canary 2% (6m) -> 20% (6m) -> 100% (rest). runtime pinned to `rk-158` for canary.

anya: console will remain behind `hdr_compat_v2` OFF. i'll flip to staged at 20% if router looks good. also, leaving a short QA playbook in the docs.

kat: i drafted the release blurb: "runtime: header normalization (rk-158); router: tolerant-match update; console: staged feature flag for header v2." preview: https://go/release-notes/1769501 (internal)

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled at 1769501200. Plan: canary(2%) -> monitor(6m) -> expand(20%) -> monitor(6m) -> full. Auto-rollback hooks enabled.

oncall: Rollback triggers (short): p95 latency increase >150ms, 5xx absolute +0.5%, gateway 502/504 spike >0.25%, console header-parse warnings >1%. If any trigger fires: stop rollout and revert runtime + router.

diego: preflight checks for oncall: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/runtime`, `kubectl get pods -l app=router -n prod`, `curl -fsS https://api.internal/health`.

morgan: assigning @anya the flag flip at 20% success. tagging @kat to publish external notes after final.

deploy-bot: Canary launched at 1769501200 -> 2% traffic. Monitoring hooks active.

oncall: 1769501560: After 6m at 2% -> p95 +4ms, 5xx flat. promoting to 20%.

anya: console harness: header-parse warnings 0.4% in canary logs (below threshold). staging flag at 20%.

diego: holding 6m at 20% before final. oncall please watch `router.latency.p95`, `runtime.5xx_rate`, and console header-warn.

oncall: 1769502260: 20% stable for 6m; metrics nominal. proceeding to full rollout.

deploy-bot: Gradewave to 100% started.

kat: publishing external release notes now.

anya: flipped console flag to 100% and retired fallback after 8m. all clean.

morgan: final signoff: rollout succeeded, closing the window. thanks all. :tada:
